title: Optimistic Hedge in General-Sum Games: Fundamental Limits and Regret Bounds via Temporal Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07078v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optimistic Hedge, a multiplicative weight update with one step of extrapolation, is one of the most natural regret-minimizing dynamics for games, and characterizing its regret has been a longstanding open question. Daskalakis, Fishelson and Golowich proved that if all $m$ players in a finite general-sum game follow Optimistic Hedge with a fixed learning rate, each player's regret is polylogarithmic in the horizon $T$. Subsequently, Ha showed that an appropriate choice of learning rate makes each player's regret bounded independently of $T$. This bound, however, is non-constructive and its dependence on the number of actions $n$ is not explicit, leaving open whether Optimistic Hedge can achieve a constant regret bound which is polynomial in the size of the game.   We show that the answer hinges on the number of players. In two-player games, there is a learning rate for which Optimistic Hedge guarantees $O(n\log n)$ regret independent of t

translated_title: 一般和博弈中的乐观Hedge算法：经由时间逼近的基本极限与遗憾界
translated_abstract: Optimistic Hedge（乐观Hedge），即带一步外推的乘法权重更新，是博弈中最自然的遗憾最小化动态之一，而刻画其遗憾值长期以来一直是一个悬而未决的问题。Daskalakis、Fishelson和Golowich证明，在有限一般和博弈中，若所有m个参与者均采用固定学习率的Optimistic Hedge，则每个参与者的遗憾在时间范围T上是多对数级的。随后，Ha证明了通过适当选择学习率，可使每个参与者的遗憾独立于T而保持有界。然而，这一界是非构造性的，且其对比特（行动）数量n的依赖关系并不明确，由此留下一个开放问题：Optimistic Hedge能否实现与博弈规模呈多项式关系的常数遗憾界。我们证明，答案取决于参与者的数量。在双人博弈中，存在某个学习率使得Optimistic Hedge保证与T无关的O(n log n)遗憾……
tldr: 本文证明了一般和博弈中Optimistic Hedge能否达到与博弈规模多项式相关的常数遗憾界取决于参与者数量，并在双人博弈情形下给出了与时间无关的O(n log n)遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that whether Optimistic Hedge can achieve a constant regret bound polynomial in the game size hinges on the number of players, and establishes a T-independent O(n log n) regret bound for two-player general-sum games.
